(* substantial presence test: 31-day floor plus weighted 3-year day count >= 183 *)
let meets_substantial_presence_test (days_current_year : int) (days_1st_preceding_year : int) (days_2nd_preceding_year : int) : bool =
  let present_31_days_current_year = days_current_year >= 31 in
  let weighted_day_sum =
    (float_of_int days_current_year *. 1.0) +.
    (float_of_int days_1st_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 3.0)) +.
    (float_of_int days_2nd_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 6.0))
  in
  let weighted_sum_meets_183 = weighted_day_sum >= 183.0 in
  present_31_days_current_year && weighted_sum_meets_183
